row: Dr. James Dawes is a Chiropractor in Murfreesboro TN serving Rutherford County. This channel is to inform and answer commonly asked questions, but remember, none of the videos are meant to diagnose or treat any specific ailments. For further information about your specific condition, please visit us at 206 N Thompson Lane, Murfreesboro TN 37129 or visit our website at www.stonesriverchiropractic.com
